overview.positionsDescription: Positions are grouped by curator, with individual holdings available when you need them.
overview.positionsEmpty: No managed positions yet. Choose a curator to start earning.
overview.programLoadError: The earn program could not be loaded.
overview.providerNotConfigured: Live earn data is unavailable in this environment — the provider API key is not configured yet.
overview.curatorsLoadError: Curator programs could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
overview.curatorsEmpty: No curator programs are available in this environment yet.
overview.curatorsDescription: Choose the team that will build and monitor the earn allocation. Each program keeps its available opportunities visible without making them the primary decision.
overview.programRateDisclosure: APY ranges are variable estimates shown for comparison only. Actual rates, allocations, and liquidity depend on the funding asset and eligible opportunities.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Funds leave the shared portfolio and settle to a Solana address you control.
withdraw.createdDescription: The withdrawal is processing. Funds settle to the destination address once the provider completes it.
withdraw.errorAmountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.

setup.curatorsDescription: Compare each curator's approach and available program opportunities. The underlying detail stays optional.
setup.allocationDescription: Optionally adjust how each stablecoin is weighted across the curator's opportunities. Weights per asset must total exactly 100%.
setup.reviewDescription: Confirm the curator program and target allocation before applying it to your organization's shared program.
setup.whatCuratorDoesDescription: Curators research yield opportunities, define risk limits, and manage allocations for you. They do not control your custody account, and every underlying holding remains visible.
setup.opportunityTransparency: These are opportunities the curator may use. Your funding asset determines the eligible initial mix, and you do not need to manage it yourself.

steakhouse.headline: Liquidity-first treasury management
steakhouse.description: Focuses on tokenized cash and short-duration treasury products, prioritizing access to funds and steadier rates.

gauntlet.headline: Actively managed onchain yield
gauntlet.description: Combines money-market funds, DeFi lending, and credit opportunities with active risk monitoring across a wider return range.
gauntlet.bestFor: Teams balancing liquidity with higher yield

sentora.headline: Focused credit and lending
sentora.description: Runs a smaller, selective set of lending and private-credit opportunities for teams comfortable with more concentration.

default.headline: Curator-managed yield
default.description: Selects and monitors eligible yield opportunities within the program mandate.
default.bestFor: Teams that want a managed allocation

setup.allocationHint: The split starts even across {curator}'s eligible opportunities. Adjust the weights, or keep the default — {curator} monitors the program either way.
setup.allocationWeightsInvalid: Use weights between 0 and 100, in steps of 0.1.
setup.sharedWalletCreateTitle: This creates your organization's shared program
setup.sharedWalletCreateBody: Confirming provisions one shared portfolio wallet for this environment and applies {curator}'s target allocation to it.
setup.sharedWalletUpdateTitle: This updates your organization's shared program
setup.sharedWalletUpdateBody: A shared program already exists for this environment. Confirming replaces its target allocation with {curator}'s weights, and existing funds rebalance to match.
setup.variableRateDisclosure: Estimated APY is variable and shown for comparison only. Final rates and liquidity depend on the curator's underlying holdings and allocation.
setup.fundingDescription: Send stablecoins on Solana to the program's deposit address. {curator} manages the allocation from there.
setup.allocationApplied: The {curator} allocation is now the program's target. Existing balances rebalance automatically.
setup.walletCreatingDescription: This usually takes under a minute. The Solana deposit address appears here as soon as the wallet is ready.
setup.walletFailed: The program wallet reports an issue. Try again in a few minutes or contact support if it persists.
setup.depositAddressExplainer: Send USDC or USDT on Solana to this address. Deposits are detected automatically and allocated to the program's target weights.
setup.depositsEmpty: No deposits detected yet. Transfers appear here shortly after they land on-chain.
setup.depositsLoadError: Deposits could not be loaded. They refresh automatically.
